pages.observation: Defect: the panel 3 balloon has no visible tail. The speaker can only be inferred from the lab tech placeholder below it. The text overflows the balloon: the 'you' of 'let you' runs past the right edge of the balloon outline. The balloon also touches the caption box at left. 'Meanwhile' has an unclear reference point: page 7 ended on a summary caption, not an ongoing action. The prescription and lab order were never shown being created (page 6 only listed 'intelligent prescribing' and 'labs' in a label), so they appear as consequences of an unseen decision. Ravi does not reply to the lab tech. The bottom tier reads correctly: tall left panel, then right upper, then right lower. The two identical 'RESULTS READY' labels are repetitive but distinguishable through their captions. Apart from the overflow, all text is legible.
